name: 51738-longprefill-granite4h-1gpu
model: ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-tiny (bfloat16), a hybrid Mamba-2 / attention mixture-of-experts model, ~15 GB of weights.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, `--distributed-executor-backend uni`, one GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=16, rate unbounded; 640 bounded requests, 10% warmup and 10% cooldown by completion, leaving 512 scored; safety cap 1800 s.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 8192 prompt tokens and exactly 32 output tokens (min = max on both), `request_format: plain`, `temperature: 0.0`, seed 1; prompts drawn independently, prefix caching off.
purpose: A document analysis assistant digesting long reports into brief answers for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments. One GPU, one in-process engine, so no host/port here.
model: ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-tiny
tensor-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: uni
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 16384
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
